name: HDMI cable 1m
description: One meter of braided HDMI for a screen on the same desk. Gold contacts and a slim plug, with just enough length to route behind a monitor arm.

name: HDMI cable 2m
description: Two meters for a display across the credenza or up on the wall. The same braid and plug, with slack that does not tug the port.

name: Keyboard
description: A compact keyboard with a low front lip so your wrists stay level. Quiet keys, a solid frame, and room left on the desk for the mouse.

name: Mouse
description: A wireless mouse with a soft matte shell and a steady sensor. Light enough to move on wood, and it pairs once.

name: USB-C cable
description: A short USB-C cable for the laptop, the hub, or the charger. Short on purpose, so it stays on the desk instead of in a tangle.

name: USB hub
description: Four ports in a small aluminum bar, fed by one cable. Room for a drive, a keyboard, and a charger while the laptop keeps a port free.

name: Portable SSD
description: A one-terabyte portable drive about as thick as a phone. It wakes when you plug it in and sleeps when you do not.

name: 65W charger
description: A 65 watt USB-C charger with folding prongs that fits in a jacket pocket. Enough for a laptop, then a phone.

name: Laptop sleeve
description: A padded sleeve with a soft lining and a firm outer shell. It slips into a backpack and keeps a 14-inch laptop from knocking around.
